say:1:1423246001:0.text: A miner just notified me about a theft case at the mine...
say:1:1423246001:0.source_cn: 刚刚有矿工来报告，说矿洞那边发生了失窃……

say:2:1423246002:0.text: This has never happened in the village before. Could you look into it?
